# NFL Daily — 2026-11-09 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Jaguars trade for DT Davon Godchaux from the Saints, a second defensive add on trade-deadline eve after already landing S Jessie Bates III from the Falcons. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50432277/sources-jaguars-get-jessie-bates-iii-trade-falcons)
- Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes is day-to-day with a right elbow injury after a hit in Sunday's win; an MRI showed no significant damage. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2119871136746123517)
- Packers RB Josh Jacobs fractured a finger in Sunday's win and will have surgery, with a possible absence of up to three weeks. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7766345/2026/11/08/josh-jacobs-finger-injury-packers-nfl/)
- Browns are returning to Deshaun Watson as the Week 10 starting QB over Shedeur Sanders despite Sanders' strong relief outing. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50433760/source-browns-returning-deshaun-watson-qb1-week-10)
- Jets edge rusher Will McDonald IV has asked to be traded; the team says it has no plans to deal him before Tuesday's deadline. [RapSheet](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2119776362580136317)
- Colts tell QB Daniel Jones he will not be traded before Tuesday's deadline. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/daniel-jones-trade-rumors-colts-nfl-deadline/)

## Transactions
- Falcons trade Pro Bowl S Jessie Bates III to the Jaguars for a 2027 2nd-round pick and a 2028 5th-round pick. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2119775874967056831)

## Injuries
- Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes (elbow) is questionable; an MRI showed no significant damage. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2119871136746123517)
- Packers RB Josh Jacobs (finger) is doubtful and set for surgery; expected to miss time. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7766345/2026/11/08/josh-jacobs-finger-injury-packers-nfl/)
- Chargers QB Justin Herbert (finger) is questionable and being tested for a possible fracture. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2119748555774869789)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-09 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- Newly acquired QB Jacoby Brissett will start Monday night against the Chargers, per coach Jesse Minter — Lamar Jackson's recovery and possible surgery remain private. [Zrebiec](https://x.com/jeffzrebiec/status/2119884306357350848)
- ESPN grades the Ravens' trade for Brissett a B+, calling the pick swap equivalent to an early Day 3 pick for a bridge starter. [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2119856611586130288)
- Giants have inquired about Ravens RB Justice Hill ahead of Tuesday's trade deadline. [BmoreBeatdown](https://x.com/BmoreBeatdown/status/2119792745363734825)
- Report: Lamar Jackson plans to return to the field this season. [BmoreBeatdown](https://x.com/BmoreBeatdown/status/2119747592712232962)
